items.name: 3x3x3 Cubes Only in Timog 2026

venue.name: Shoppes at Victoria
venue.address: Victoria Tower, Panay Ave, Diliman, Quezon City, 1103 Metro Manila

items.information:
Get your cubes ready and test your speed! Join us for a full day of official 3x3x3 speedcubing action recognized by the World Cube Association (WCA) and the Philippine Cubers Association (PCA)!

🏆 FEATURED EVENTS:
3x3x3 Cube (Main Event) (Dual Rounds)
3x3x3 One-Handed (Dual Rounds)
3x3x3 Blindfolded
3x3x3 Multi-Blind 

💳 Registration Fee:
Regular Registration: ₱500 (covers all events)
On-the-Spot Registration: ₱600 (subject to slot availability on competition day)

🗓 Registration Schedule:Registration Opens: September 21, 2026

Slots are filled on a first-paid, first-served basis. Secure your spot early!

📲 Payment Details: Please refer to the Extra Registration Requirements on this WCA competition page for complete payment instructions and proof of payment submission instructions before registering.

See you all at the competition floor! 🔥

items.name: Berkeley Sides 2026

venue.name: SOCS 20
venue.details: This venue is NOT the normal Pauley Ballroom venue!

items.information:
## This competition has a per-event competitor limit. Please read the [per-competitor event limit page](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BerkeleySides2026#81150-per-event-competitor-limit) for more information.

* Registrants will be accepted in the order that they pay, not the order that they register. Please be patient with us as we manually accept all eligible competitors.
* Competitors and spectators under the age of 18 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian.
* Berkeley Cube Club and West Coast Cubing do not provide supervision and cannot assume responsibility for personal safety or belongings.

items.information:

A verseny összes számára együttesen vonatkozó, 35 perces kumulatív limit érvényes. A versenyszámokat tetszés szerinti sorrendben lehet lerakni.
​
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcWtsIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--a418957a26bf064989b7de2ff14f6260f20fa9c3/UK.png)

Martinsville Minis: Big Cubes 2026 


Please Note:  This competition does NOT include 3x3x3. 


EVENTS:
4x4 - 3 Rounds
5x5 - 3 Rounds
6x6 - 3 Rounds
7x7 - 3 Rounds

This competition is being supported by Midwest Cubing Association. Central Indiana Speedcubing Club is helping with setup and tear down.

The venue allows food & non alcoholic drinks to be brought in.  It is a non smoking venue.  As always, be courteous and clean up any spills & trash.
